scenes.script_line: New projects, new partnerships, ideas at various stages — some will happen, some won't. What I can promise you is that growth, for us, is never expansion for its own sake. Every new point in the constellation has to regenerate something — a building, a community, a piece of land — or we don't do it. We grow the way the farm grows: season by season, roots first.
scenes.visual_direction: Growth the way the farm grows — season by season, roots first

scenes.script_line: You joined a company that is trying to prove something to an entire industry: that hospitality can give back more than it takes. Every unit in this constellation is an argument in that proof. And every shift you work is a line in the argument. Next module: the moment every hospitality career is really tested — when things go wrong.
